meta.title: Vendor from another company not in audience is refused when submitting a bid
gaps: Log in to the Procol API with a buyer token that can view the stage but lacks reject permission
Send PATCH /bids/<bid_id>/reject using that token and verify HTTP 422 with error code 455 (R-BID-030-7) and message "Not authorized to reject bid"
